examples.en: The rule is a paper tiger.
The powerful-looking organisation turned out to be a paper tiger.
examples.zh: 這個看似強大的組織結果只是外強中乾。

meaning.en: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.
meaning.zh: 一個看似或聲稱強大、危險、嚴厲或有效，但實際上缺乏真正實力、權力或作用的人、團體、組織、規則、威脅、制度或情況。
naturalZh: 一個看似或聲稱強大、危險、嚴厲或有效，但實際上缺乏真正實力、權力或作用的人、團體、組織、規則、威脅、制度或情況。

register.summaryEn: The expression is common in conversation, journalism, presentations and general commentary. Its tone is normally critical, disapproving or dismissive. It is not a swear word, but calling a person a paper tiger directly may sound insulting because it suggests that the person’s confidence or power is largely false. Cambridge specifically labels the expression as disapproving.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達常見於對話、新聞報道、簡報和一般評論。 語氣通常帶有批評、不認同或輕視意味。 它不是粗俗用語，但直接把一個人稱為 a paper tiger 可能帶有侮辱性，因為這暗示對方的自信或權力大部分只是表象。
contextsEn: The threat is a paper tiger
The organisation proved to be a paper tiger
contextsZh: only、just、probably 和 actually 等副詞
對比表面形象和實際情況的子句。
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 只在原檔說明的合適情境中使用這個慣用語。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.example: The rule is a paper tiger.

forms.example: Without proper checks, the rule may become a paper tiger.

forms.form: Subject + see / describe / treat + X + as + a paper tiger.
forms.example: Staff saw the new system as a paper tiger.

forms.form: Subject + call + X + a paper tiger.
forms.example: Even its supporters began to call the campaign a paper tiger.

forms.form: X + be + not + a paper tiger.
forms.example: The coach was not a paper tiger; he had the power to carry out his decision.

examples.en: The coach was not a paper tiger; he had the power to carry out his decision.
examples.zh: 這位教練並非外強中乾；他有能力執行自己的決定。

benefits.titleEn: It Expresses a Strong Appearance–Reality Contrast
benefits.titleZh: 清楚表達表象與現實的落差
benefits.en: The expression immediately tells the listener that something impressive or frightening lacks real strength.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以立即說明某人或某事雖然看來強大或可怕，實際上卻缺乏真正力量。

benefits.en: The rule is a paper tiger.
benefits.zh: 慣用語把「表面嚴格但實際沒有作用」濃縮成一個容易記憶的表達。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Evaluate Rules and Organisations
benefits.en: The expression is useful when discussing a rule, policy, system or organisation that has an impressive appearance but lacks action, money, staff or authority.
benefits.zh: 當一項規則、政策、制度或組織看來氣勢十足，卻缺乏行動、資金、人手或權力時，這個表達十分實用。

benefits.titleZh: 可以減輕不必要的恐懼
benefits.zh: 這個團體看來很可怕，但可能只是一隻紙老虎。

benefits.en: Calling a warning or system a paper tiger communicates that it has failed to produce the effect it promised.
benefits.zh: 把警告或制度稱為 a paper tiger，可以簡潔指出它沒有產生原先承諾的作用。

benefits.en: Students may meet the expression in news reports, interviews, discussions and commentary. Understanding its critical tone prevents a literal misunderstanding.
benefits.zh: 學生可能會在新聞報道、訪問、討論和評論中遇到這個表達。 理解其批評語氣，可以避免把它誤解為字面上的紙製老虎。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented English Use; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 英語用法有較充分記錄；確切首次用法不明

history.en: The same metaphor is established in Chinese as 「紙老虎」, meaning a person or group that has an impressive show of power but lacks real strength. Merriam-Webster records the first known English use in 1836. This date identifies an early surviving record; it does not prove when the expression was first created.
history.zh: 中文早已有「紙老虎」這個比喻，形容空有威勢而沒有真正實力的人或集團。 Merriam-Webster 把目前所知的早期英語用法追溯至1836年。 這個年份代表現存的早期記錄，並不能證明表達正是在該年創造。

history.en: The physical contrast between a frightening tiger and weak paper naturally came to represent the contrast between apparent power and actual weakness.
history.zh: 可怕的老虎與脆弱的紙張形成鮮明對比，逐漸被用來表示「表面強大、實際薄弱」。

origin.memoryEn: A real tiger has strength; a paper tiger has only the appearance of strength.
origin.memoryZh: 真正的老虎擁有力量；紙老虎只有強大的外表。

rules.titleEn: Both Sides of the Contrast Must Be Present
rules.titleZh: 規則一：必須包含對比的兩面
rules.en: 1. appears powerful, frightening, strict or effective; 2. is actually weak, harmless, powerless or ineffective.
rules.zh: 只有在某人或某事表面強大、可怕、嚴厲或有效，但實際上薄弱、無害、無權或無效時，才適合使用這個慣用語。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Simply to Mean “Weak”
rules.titleZh: 規則二：不要把它當作 weak 的普通同義詞
rules.en: One defeat alone does not show that the team previously appeared powerful but was actually weak.
rules.zh: 單純弱小或一次失敗並不足以構成 a paper tiger。 語境必須先建立強大的表象。

rules.titleEn: Suitable Subjects Must Be Capable of Appearing Powerful
rules.titleZh: 規則四：主語必須能夠呈現強大表象
rules.en: Suitable Subjects Must Be Capable of Appearing Powerful
rules.zh: 主語必須能夠呈現強大表象

rules.titleEn: Give Evidence of the Weakness Where Necessary
rules.titleZh: 規則五：在有需要時提供實際弱點的證據
rules.en: Give Evidence of the Weakness Where Necessary
rules.zh: 新規則形同虛設，因為沒有人檢查大家有沒有遵守。

rules.titleEn: “Not a Paper Tiger” Has the Opposite Meaning
rules.titleZh: 規則八：not a paper tiger 表示相反意思
rules.en: This means that the rule has real force and will genuinely be applied.
rules.zh: 這表示規則並非只是表面強硬，而是真正具有作用並會得到執行。

rules.titleZh: 規則九：形容人物時要小心使用
rules.en: Calling somebody a paper tiger suggests that their strength, confidence or authority is false or exaggerated. Use it carefully in professional or polite situations.
rules.zh: 把某人稱為 a paper tiger，暗示對方的實力、自信或權威只是誇大表象。 在專業或禮貌場合應小心使用。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要混淆字面上的紙老虎
rules.zh: 孩子在美術課製作了一隻紙老虎。 這個看似可怕的組織其實外強中乾。

examples.en: The child made a paper tiger in art class.
examples.zh: 孩子在美術課製作了一隻紙老虎。

examples.en: The frightening organisation was actually a paper tiger.
examples.zh: 這個看似可怕的組織其實外強中乾。

rules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要過度使用
rules.en: A plain word such as weak, ineffective, powerless or empty may be clearer when there is no meaningful contrast between appearance and reality.
rules.zh: 如果語境沒有「表面強大、實際薄弱」的明顯對比，使用 weak、ineffective、powerless 或 empty 可能更加清楚自然。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using a paper tiger.
instructions.zh: 使用 a paper tiger 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Ryan frightens younger pupils and talks as if he is powerful. However, he backs down whenever someone answers him calmly.
questions.promptZh: Ryan 會恐嚇年幼學生，說話時好像很有勢力；可是，每當有人冷靜回應，他便會退縮。
questions.answer: Ryan is a paper tiger: he frightens younger pupils but backs down when anyone answers him calmly.
questions.answerZh: Ryan 其實只是一隻紙老虎；他會恐嚇年幼學生，但只要有人冷靜回應，他便會退縮。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The club rule looks very strict, but nobody checks whether members follow it.
questions.promptZh: 這項會所規則看來十分嚴格，但沒有人檢查會員有沒有遵守。
questions.answer: This strict-looking club rule is a paper tiger because nobody checks whether members follow it.
questions.answerZh: 這項看似嚴格的會所規則其實形同虛設，因為沒有人檢查會員有沒有遵守。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The online message sounded threatening, but the sender did nothing afterwards.
questions.promptZh: 那則網上訊息語帶威嚇，但發訊息的人之後甚麼也沒有做。
questions.answer: That threatening online message was a paper tiger because the sender did nothing afterwards.
questions.answerZh: 那則帶有威嚇意味的網上訊息其實只是虛張聲勢，因為發訊息的人之後甚麼也沒有做。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The shop called its notice a “final warning”, but no action followed.
questions.promptZh: 店舖把通告稱為「最後警告」，但之後沒有採取任何行動。
questions.answer: In reality, the shop’s “final warning” was a paper tiger because no action followed.
questions.answerZh: 實際上，店舖的「最後警告」只是一項空洞威嚇，因為之後沒有採取任何行動。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The rival team looked extremely strong before the match, but it played badly and lost easily.
questions.promptZh: 對手在比賽前看來非常強勁，但實際表現很差，輕易便落敗。
questions.answer: Although the rival team looked extremely strong, it was a paper tiger once the match began.
questions.answerZh: 雖然對手看來非常強勁，但比賽一開始便顯出它外強中乾。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The old security system looked impressive, but it could not stop anyone from entering.
questions.promptZh: 舊有保安系統看來十分厲害，但根本無法阻止任何人進入。
questions.answer: Because it could not stop anyone from entering, the impressive old security system was a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 這套看似厲害的舊保安系統根本無法阻止任何人進入，因此只是虛有其表。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The manager threatened to close the project, but she did not have permission to do so.
questions.promptZh: 經理威脅要終止項目，但她其實沒有權限這樣做。
questions.answer: Her threat to close the project was a paper tiger because she had no permission to do so.
questions.answerZh: 她威脅要終止項目，其實只是虛張聲勢，因為她根本沒有權限這樣做。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The organisation had an impressive name and website, but it had almost no staff or money.
questions.promptZh: 這個組織有一個響亮的名稱和精美的網站，但幾乎沒有員工或資金。
questions.answer: What appeared to be a powerful organisation was a paper tiger with almost no staff or money.
questions.answerZh: 這個看似強大的組織其實外強中乾，幾乎沒有員工或資金。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The school announced a tough punishment rule, but teachers never used it.
questions.promptZh: 學校公布了一項嚴厲的懲罰規則，但老師從來沒有執行。
questions.answer: The school’s punishment rule proved to be a paper tiger because teachers never used it.
questions.answerZh: 學校的懲罰規則結果形同虛設，因為老師從來沒有執行。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The local group had an impressive name, but it had no real influence in the community.
questions.promptZh: 這個地區團體名稱響亮，但在社區內其實沒有真正影響力。
questions.answer: Behind its impressive name, the local group was only a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 在響亮名稱背後，這個地區團體其實有名無實。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: At first, the committee seemed powerful. We later learnt that it could not make any decisions.
questions.promptZh: 起初，這個委員會看來很有權力；後來我們才知道，它根本不能作出任何決定。
questions.answer: At first, the committee seemed powerful, but it proved to be a paper tiger when we learnt that it could not make any decisions.
questions.answerZh: 起初，這個委員會看來很有權力；但當我們得知它不能作出任何決定時，便發現它有名無實。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The centre once checked this ban carefully, but it has now stopped checking it.
questions.promptZh: 這間中心以往會仔細檢查人們有沒有遵守禁令，但現在已停止檢查。
questions.answer: The ban became a paper tiger when the centre stopped checking it.
questions.answerZh: 中心停止檢查後，這項禁令便變得形同虛設。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The new rule looks strict, but it may have no real effect if nobody makes people follow it.
questions.promptZh: 新規則看來很嚴格，但如果沒有人要求大家遵守，它可能完全沒有實際作用。
questions.answer: Without anyone to make people follow it, the new rule may become a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 如果沒有人要求大家遵守，新規則可能會變得形同虛設。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The customer has threatened to take us to court, but no lawyer has contacted us. His threat may not be as powerful as it sounds.
questions.promptZh: 顧客威脅要控告我們，但至今沒有律師聯絡我們。他的威脅可能沒有聽起來那麼有力。
questions.answer: Perhaps the customer’s legal threat is a paper tiger, since no lawyer has contacted us.
questions.answerZh: 顧客的法律威脅或許只是虛張聲勢，因為至今沒有律師聯絡我們。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The company has issued several strong warnings, but it has never taken action on any of them.
questions.promptZh: 公司曾發出多次強硬警告，但從來沒有就任何一次警告採取行動。
questions.answer: After failing to act on any of its warnings, the company has shown that it is a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 公司從未就任何警告採取行動，已顯示自己外強中乾。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The mayor’s plan sounds bold, but it will have no real effect unless the town provides money and workers.
questions.promptZh: 市長的計劃聽來很有魄力，但除非市內提供資金和人手，否則不會產生實際作用。
questions.answer: Unless the town provides money and workers, the mayor’s plan will remain a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 除非市內提供資金和人手，否則市長的計劃只會徒具聲勢，缺乏實效。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: A: That message sounds frightening. Is the sender really able to harm us? B: Maybe not. The message may only look powerful.
questions.promptZh: 甲：那則訊息聽來很可怕。發訊息的人真的有能力傷害我們嗎？ 乙：未必。那則訊息可能只是看來很有威力。
questions.answer: It may simply be a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 它可能只是一隻紙老虎。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: Some people thought the coach only looked powerful. In fact, he had the power and support to carry out his decision.
questions.promptZh: 有些人以為教練只是表面強勢；事實上，他有權力和支持去執行自己的決定。
questions.answer: The coach was not a paper tiger; he had the power and support to carry out his decision.
questions.answerZh: 這位教練並非外強中乾；他有權力和支持去執行自己的決定。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The new policy looks strong, but it could lose all real effect if managers continue to ignore it.
questions.promptZh: 新政策看來很有力度，但如果經理繼續不理會，它可能會失去所有實際作用。
questions.answer: If managers continue to ignore it, the new policy could turn into a paper tiger.
questions.answerZh: 如果經理繼續不理會，新政策可能會變得形同虛設。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: The protection system looked strong, but it failed the first simple test.
questions.promptZh: 這套防護系統看來很可靠，但在第一次簡單測試中便失效。
questions.answer: What looked like a strong protection system was actually a paper tiger because it failed the first simple test.
questions.answerZh: 這套看似強大的防護系統其實只是虛有其表，因為它在第一次簡單測試中便失效。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, group, organisation, rule, threat, system or situation that appears or claims to be powerful, dangerous, strict or effective but actually has little real strength, power or effect.

questions.prompt: My friend was frightened by the group’s strong image. I explained that it had very few members and no clear plan.
questions.promptZh: 朋友被這個團體的強勢形象嚇倒；我向他解釋，這個團體其實成員很少，也沒有清晰計劃。
questions.answer: I told my friend that the frightening group might be a paper tiger because it had few members and no clear plan.
